errors.ONBOARDING_FORM_EXISTS: This project already has a form. Reload the page.
errors.ONBOARDING_INVALID_TRANSITION: This status change is not possible.
errors.ONBOARDING_NOT_EDITABLE: The structure is fixed by now and can no longer be changed.
errors.ONBOARDING_REVIEW_INCOMPLETE: The review is not finished yet.

project.title: Onboarding

empty.title: No onboarding started yet
empty.description: The onboarding collects every detail and file for this project before the work begins. You pick a template and adjust the form to this project.
empty.readOnlyDescription: The onboarding lets the team collect every detail and file for this project before the work begins. None has been started for this project yet.

project.notEligible: An onboarding can only be started for planned and active projects.
project.draftHint: The form is a draft. The customer cannot see it yet.
project.progressNone: The form has no required fields yet.

dialog.title: Start onboarding
dialog.description: This creates a draft with its own copies of the blocks. You adjust it for this project afterwards; the customer cannot see it yet.
dialog.templateHint: Later changes to the template do not affect this form.
dialog.blankHint: The form starts without blocks. You add them from the catalog or create your own.
dialog.noTemplates: There is no active template yet. You can start empty and add blocks in the form.
dialog.prefillHint: Company-wide answers are taken over from this customer's last completed onboarding.

answers.empty: This form has no blocks yet. Once it has, the answers of the customer appear here.

progress.label: {answered} of {total} required answers given
progress.none: The form has no required answers.

blocks.empty: This form has no blocks yet. Add some from the catalog or create your own.

picker.title: Add a block from the catalog
picker.description: The form gets its own copy. Only active blocks that are not in the form yet.
picker.empty: Every active block is already in the form.

ownDialog.title: Own block
ownDialog.description: This block exists only in this form. You add fields and further languages afterwards.

hints.key: Internal name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Suggested from the title.

removeDialog.title: Remove block?
removeDialog.description: “{name}” is removed from this form with all its fields and answers. Attached files stay in the customer's file area.

fieldDeleteDialog.title: Delete field?
fieldDeleteDialog.descriptionGroup: “{name}” is deleted from this form with all its sub-fields.
fieldDeleteDialog.usageNone: This field has no answers and no files yet.
fieldDeleteDialog.usage: This affects {answers} and {files}. The answers are lost. The files stay in the customer's file area; only their link to the form is removed.
fieldDeleteDialog.usageFailed: The number of affected answers could not be loaded. Existing answers to this field are lost when you delete it.

editor.heading: Edit block
editor.select: Pick a block from the list to edit its texts and fields.
editor.locked: After the submission the structure is fixed. Request what is missing in the review.
editor.readOnly: You can view this form but not change it.
editor.conflict: Someone has changed the form in the meantime. The current state is loaded, please repeat your change.
